<thought>We need the template that converts a carboxylic ester into an aldehyde (and generates an aliphatic hydroxyl). Using the correct functional group names from the available list, we search for templates that break “carboxylic esters” and form both “aldehydes” and “aliphatic hydroxyls” for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
